en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to teach students the theory of basic technological processes in the processing of horticultural products into food products and to apply it in the calculation of the main parameters of the used technical equipment.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Making models of technological processes and their utilization, quantification of processes (allowance 2/1)2.Transport systems - calculation of conveyor efficiency and pump efficiency; design of transport systems (allowance 4/2)3.Sorting, separation - sieving theory, screening and screen option (allowance 2/1)4.Washing and cleaning products - calculation of parameters of drum washer for vegetables (allowance 2/1)5.Crushing, grinding - parameters of crusher and final product, crusher efficiency (allowance 2/1)6.Mixing, homogenization - mixing flow, types of mixers, calculation of mixer power (allowance 2/1)7.Pressing - calculation of pressing pressure for hydraulic and mechanical presses (allowance 2/1)8.Sedimentation - process description, calculation of particle sedimentation velocity (allowance 2/1)9.Heat operations - heat exchanger calculation (allowance 4/2)10.Filtration - flow of liquid through the filter, calculation of the flow through the insert and alluvial filter (allowance 2/1)11.Cooling, freezing - characteristics of the cooling circuit (allowance 2/1)12.Packaging - systems of packing lines, principles of synchronization, calculation of parameters during filling (allowance 2/1)
